def solution():
    # Define variables
    principal = 5_000_000
    annual_interest_rate = 0.058
    loan_term_years = 10

    # Do math calculation to get the monthly mortgage repayment
    monthly_interest_rate = annual_interest_rate / 12
    total_payments = loan_term_years * 12

    monthly_payment = (
        principal * monthly_interest_rate
        / (1 - (1 + monthly_interest_rate) ** (-total_payments))
    )

    # Return the answer rounded to three decimal places
    return round(monthly_payment, 3)
